# files=9 commands=65

=== luo:math/comptime ===
scoreboard players set #math.-1 math -1
scoreboard players set #math.0 math 0
scoreboard players set #math.1 math 1
scoreboard players set #math.2 math 2
scoreboard players set #math.3 math 3
=== luo:math/init ===
scoreboard objectives add a0 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add l2 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add l3 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add l4 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add l5 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add l9 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add math dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add return dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add t0 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add t1 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add t2 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add t3 dummy ggm
scoreboard objectives add ggm.c dummy ggm
scoreboard players set #2 ggm.c 2
scoreboard players set #4 ggm.c 4
scoreboard players set #1234 ggm.c 1234
scoreboard players set #67108864 ggm.c 67108864
scoreboard players set #1103515245 ggm.c 1103515245
=== luo:math/is_happen_fix1000 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l5 = seed math
scoreboard players operation @s l5 *= #1103515245 ggm.c
scoreboard players operation @s l5 += #1234 ggm.c
scoreboard players operation @s l5 %= #67108864 ggm.c
scoreboard players set @s l9 1000
scoreboard players operation @s t2 = @s l5
scoreboard players operation @s t2 -= @s a0
scoreboard players set @s t3 0
execute @s[score_t2=0] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s t3 1
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s t3
=== luo:math/lcg_step ===
scoreboard players operation @s return = #1103515245 ggm.c
scoreboard players operation @s return *= @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s return += #1234 ggm.c
scoreboard players operation @s return %= #67108864 ggm.c
=== luo:math/load ===
scoreboard players set seed math 12345
=== luo:math/sqrt ===
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= #4 ggm.c
execute @s[score_t0=-1] ~ ~ ~ scoreboard players set @s return 1
function luo:math/sqrt$b2 unless @s[score_t0=-1]
=== luo:math/sqrt$b2 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l2 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s l2 /= #4 ggm.c
scoreboard players set @s l3 0
scoreboard players set @s l4 32
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= @s l3
function luo:math/sqrt$b3 unless @s[score_t0_min=0,score_t0=0]
function luo:math/sqrt$b4 if @s[score_t0_min=0,score_t0=0]
=== luo:math/sqrt$b3 ===
scoreboard players operation @s l3 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s a0
scoreboard players operation @s t0 /= @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t1 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t1 += @s t0
scoreboard players operation @s l2 = @s t1
scoreboard players operation @s l2 /= #2 ggm.c
scoreboard players operation @s t0 = @s l2
scoreboard players operation @s t0 -= @s l3
scoreboard players remove @s l4 1
execute @s[score_l4_min=1,score_t0=-1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_l4_min=1,score_t0_min=1] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b3
execute @s[score_l4=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
execute @s[score_t0_min=0,score_t0=0] ~ ~ ~ function luo:math/sqrt$b4
=== luo:math/sqrt$b4 ===
scoreboard players operation @s return = @s l2
